[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Invisible''' was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. Currently, it can only be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode if the player has the Sandbox Plus+ [[Gamepasses|gamepass]]. The '''Invisible''' cannot be attacked by towers without hidden detection. Compared to the [[Abnormal]], it is slightly faster than it. It also has more health than the [[Hefty]]. The '''Invisible''' could be spawned by the [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] on [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. The [[Mystery]] could also spawn the '''Invisible''' upon its death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Invisible''' is a completely transparent enemy with a slightly noticeable light blue outline. It is faceless. It will fade completely, then fade back into view at regular intervals. ==Strategy== This strategy refers to the state of the game while the '''Invisible''' still appeared in the [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. *Towers with hidden detection are the best way to attack the '''Invisible'''. **Most early game towers gain hidden detection. Such towers are recommended to deal with early '''Invisibles'''. ***Towers such as the [[Militant]] or the [[Golden Soldier]] are good example. ***As the '''Invisible''' spawns in hordes, the [[Golden Pyromancer]] is particularly useful. ***The [[Warden]] is also a great option, although it is slightly costly to get. **Towers like [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are likely too expensive for when '''Invisibles''' debut. However, they are great at dealing with '''Invisibles''' later on in the game. *For splash damage towers that cannot target '''Invisibles''', such as the [[Mortar]], if an '''Invisible''' is caught up in an explosion, they will be dealt splash damage. **This means that another detectable [[Enemies|enemy]] must be near the '''Invisible''' for a splash damage tower to hit the '''Invisible'''. *[[Units]] (like [[Military Base]] vehicles) cannot target the '''Invisibles''' but can damage '''Invisibles''' through collision. **The Level 2 [[Military Base]] is viable against '''Invisibles'''. **The [[Pistol Goon]] and [[Tommy Goon 1]] do have hidden detection though, so they can be useful against the '''Invisible'''. ***However, do not rely on the [[Pistol Goon]]s, as they do not have enough DPS to suffice. *The [[Frost Blaster]] can be quite useful against the '''Invisible''' because of its freeze and piercing projectile. *Multiple Level 0 or 1 [[Trapper]]s can also be a good counter against '''Invisibles'''. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseInvisible.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexInvisible.png|'''Invisible''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Invisible''', true to its name, is barely noticeable. **The '''Invisible''' can be even harder to notice in maps with bright colors. *During private Hardcore testing, the '''Invisible''' had 35 health. *When killed, the '''Invisible''' leaves behind the same particles the [[Mystery]] does. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Invisible''' added. *'''2 August 2024''' - [[v1.27.0]] **{{Bug}} Now emits the [[Mystery]]'s death particles on death. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Invisible''' removed from the main game, as it has been replaced by [[Phantom]]. Now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. **No longer appears in the [[Index]]. {{Hardcore|[[Hefty]]|Wave 7|Invisible|Wave 10|[[Balloon]]|Wave 12|category = hide}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
